coverage.note: Official history and current Wynnchurch portfolio evidence cover founding and bounded ownership context; exact equity remains a warning.
Company reporting and location pages cover the Canadian workforce, headquarters, facilities, supplier geography and public contact route.
Official managed-program and defence pages plus DND service evidence define Logistik's clothing, equipment and lifecycle-delivery mandate.
NP Aerospace supports the public Women’s Armour System component split and configurations, but detailed Logistik carrier specifications remain unavailable.
Contract and partner sources establish awarded, amended and field-ready language, while delivery, acceptance and named adoption remain unresolved.
CanadaBuys, DND and Open Government provide exact DICE and OCFC2 contract and managed-service evidence.
The public procurement record establishes DICE and OCFC2 roles, values and dates while preserving option, amendment-scope and delivery boundaries.
Wynnchurch sources and NRC IRAP agreement 1038022 cover the portfolio relationship and bounded connected-PPE contribution.
The official contact page provides a specific contact URL, general email and telephone number.
CanadaBuys amendment 004 is the newest qualified dated event and supports both the current-activity text and date.
The candidate uses independent official company, government procurement, Open Government, partner and industry-publication source families.
DND and CanadaBuys publish different initial DICE value bases; neither is declared incorrect and the unresolved basis is preserved for review.

saturation.stopReason: French official mirrors added terminology only, and final sitemap, robots, exact product-document, customer-corroboration and certificate-authority probes produced no new decision-changing claim.

warnings: CanadaBuys does not disclose what equipment, quantity or service amendment 004 adds, and no reviewed official source confirms DICE delivery, acceptance or fielding.
NP Aerospace calls the joint Women's Armour System field-ready, but no reviewed durable source identifies a buyer, contract, delivery, acceptance or in-service deployment for the complete system.
Logistik reports a hybrid factory, supplier and commercial sourcing model; public sources do not identify the manufacturer of every item delivered under its managed programs.
Wynnchurch still lists Logistik as a portfolio company, but current equity percentages and ultimate beneficial ownership are not publicly disclosed.
NRC IRAP agreement 1038022 establishes a C$75,000 feasibility proof of concept, not a successful technical outcome, product readiness, customer or deployment.
DND's C$19.7 million initial DICE value excluding tax and CanadaBuys' C$24,224,260.49 base-page value have different unexplained public bases and are not combined.
